resources.string: Aula lives on your Mac or your server. To reach it from here, sign in to Tailscale with the same account you used there. You only do this once.
When you’re done, come back to Aula: it carries on by itself.
Your Tailscale network asks for new devices to be approved. Whoever manages it can do so in the admin panel; Aula carries on by itself once they do.

On your Mac, open Aula → Settings → “Aula on your devices”, turn it on and sign in to Tailscale with this same account. If your Aula is a server, check that it is running and on Tailscale with this account.
I found “%1$s” on your network, but Aula isn’t answering. Check that the computer is on (a Mac, awake and with Aula open). I’ll keep trying every few seconds.
Which Aula do you want to open?
There is more than one Aula on your network. Choose one: next time it opens by itself. To change, Settings → Open another Aula.
This device will leave your private network. Your courses stay where your Aula is.
There is no browser on this device to open the page.
